paper_title: Towards a More Inclusive AI Progress and Perspectives in Large Language   Model Training for the Sámi Language
caption: The distribution of tokens and sentences across different domains in the SALT dataset is shown.

annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the number of sentences in thousands (K) across various categories. The horizontal axis presents these categories, labeled as "Administrative", "Religion", "Non-fiction", "Fiction", "Law", "News", "Science", and "Blogs", with no apparent specific order. The vertical axis represents the number of sentences in thousands, labeled "Sentences (K)," with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 800, marked at intervals of 200. Each bar is colored in light red and annotated with its exact value in blue above the bar. The bars represent the following approximate values: Administrative at 525K, Religion at 50K, Non-fiction at 190K, Fiction at 35K, Law at 23K, News at 902K, Science at 110K, and Blogs at 2K. The tallest bar is for News at 902K, and the shortest bar is for Blogs at 2K. None of the bars appear visually emphasized beyond their annotation with exact values.
